attchmntText: Natural Capsules Limited has informed the Exchange about General Updates
voiceSummary: Natural Capsules Limited filed a corrigendum regarding its Unaudited Consolidated Financial Results for the six months ended September 30, 2026. The company corrected an inadvertent typographical error in the decimal placement within the Consolidated Segment-Wise Revenue statement. Previously reported figures for Segment Revenue were erroneously stated as 90,501.62 Lakhs for Capsules, 9,363.07 Lakhs for API, and a total of 99,864.69 Lakhs. The revised and corrected figures are 9,050.16 Lakhs for Capsules, 936.31 Lakhs for API, and a total of 9,986.47 Lakhs. The company confirmed that the corrected Consolidated Income from Operations of 9,986.47 Lakhs aligns with the Revenue from Operations reported in the Consolidated Statement of Profit and Loss submitted on November 13, 2026. There is no change in Segment Results, Segment Assets, Segment Liabilities, Capital Employed, or any other figures in the Unaudited Standalone and Consolidated Financial Results for the quarter and six months ended September 30, 2026.

attchmntText: Natural Capsules Limited has informed the Exchange regarding 'Board Comments on the Fine Levied by Stock Exchanges under Regulation 29 of SEBI(LODR) Regulations, 2015'.
voiceSummary: Natural Capsules Limited filed a notice regarding fines levied by the National Stock Exchange of India Limited and BSE Limited. The exchanges imposed a fine of Rs. 10,000 plus applicable GST each under Regulation 29 of the SEBI LODR Regulations 2015. The penalty was for non-compliance with the requirement to provide two working days' prior advance notice for the Board Meeting held on September 02, 2026. The Board noted the meeting was convened at shorter notice due to the delayed receipt of an Independent Valuation Report on August 31, 2026. The company has deposited the requisite fine amount. The Board advised management to ensure strict adherence to advance notice timelines in future corporate actions.

attchmntText: Natural Capsules Limited has informed the Exchange regarding Outcome of Board Meeting held on November 13, 2026.
voiceSummary: Natural Capsules Limited approved the unaudited financial results for the quarter and half year ended September 2026. The Board approved the preferential allotment of 1,12,500 equity shares and 4,50,000 fully convertible warrants to promoter Sunil L Mundra. The equity shares are issued at Rs. 178 per share, aggregating to Rs. 2,00,25,000. The warrants are issued at Rs. 178 per warrant, aggregating to Rs. 8,01,00,000. Each warrant carries an option to subscribe to one equity share. Twenty-five percent upfront subscription money is required for the warrants. The remaining balance is payable upon conversion. Warrants can be exercised within 18 months from the allotment date. Post-allotment, the promoter's shareholding is projected to increase to 10.61 percent, assuming full conversion of warrants. In-principle approvals from BSE and NSE were received on November 4, 2026. Shareholder approval was obtained at the Extra-Ordinary General Meeting on September 9, 2026.
